about_the_game:
Catwifhat is a clicker & collection game where you gather cats, items, talismans, cosmetics, tools, and even rare weapons.
By clicking on adorable cats in hats, you earn loot, unlock new collectibles, and expand your growing collection.


Every 3 hours in the game, you receive a unique cat.


3 hour drop pool chance:


  • COMMON = 70%
  • UNCOMMON = 16%
  • RARE = 3.5%
  • EPIC = 0.499%
  • LEGENDARY = 0.00099% (1 / 101,010)
  • MYTHIC = 0.00001% (1 / 10,000,000)
  • SPECIAL = Available during events
  • LITTER BOX = 10%

Key Features:


  • Clicking Drop System — earn items by clicking (Lockpick, Master Key, more coming soon)
  • Collect cats, items, talismans, cosmetics, materials, tools and future weapon drops
  • Litter Boxes — open them with Lockpicks to receive cats and valuable items
  • Autoclickers — click for you even in the background
  • Rewards System — claim rewards up to LVL 20 (more on the way)
  • Improved visuals and redesigned UI elements
  • Music, click sounds & adjustable audio settings

Join our community and help us create something amazing!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 5500 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 400 / AMD Radeon HD 7000
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 10500 / AMD Ryzen 7+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 700 / AMD Radeon Rx 200
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Catwifhat is a cozy clicker where you collect cats, items, talismans, cosmetics and more! Click to expand your collection, discover rare drops, and earn a new unique cat every 3 hours. Relax, have fun, and build the ultimate cat collection!
